record.bible_text: And the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> came unto me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, prophesy<WH05012><WTH8734> against the prophets<WH05030> of Israel<WH03478> that prophesy<WH05012><WTH8737>, and say<WH0559><WTH8804> thou unto them that prophesy<WH05030> out of their own hearts<WH03820>, Hear<WH08085><WTH8798> ye the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068>; <RF>that prophesy out...: Heb. that are prophets out of their own hearts<Rf>

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Woe<WH01945> unto the foolish<WH05036> prophets<WH05030>, that follow<WH01980><WTH8802><WH0310> their own spirit<WH07307>, and have seen<WH07200><WTH8804> nothing! <RF>follow: Heb. walk after<Rf> <RF>and...: or, and things which they have not seen<Rf>
O Israel<WH03478>, thy prophets<WH05030> are like the foxes<WH07776> in the deserts<WH02723>.

Ye have not gone up<WH05927><WTH8804> into the gaps<WH06556>, neither made up<WH01443><WTH8799> the hedge<WH01447> for the house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478> to stand<WH05975><WTH8800> in the battle<WH04421> in the day<WH03117> of the LORD<WH03068>. <RF>gaps: or, breaches<Rf> <RF>made...: Heb. hedged the hedge<Rf>

They have seen<WH02372><WTH8804> vanity<WH07723> and lying<WH03577> divination<WH07081>, saying<WH0559><WTH8802>, The LORD<WH03068> saith<WH05002><WTH8803>: and the LORD<WH03068> hath not sent<WH07971><WTH8804> them: and they have made <FI>others<Fi> to hope<WH03176><WTH8765> that they would confirm<WH06965><WTH8763> the word<WH01697>.

Have ye not seen<WH02372><WTH8804> a vain<WH07723> vision<WH04236>, and have ye not spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> a lying<WH03577> divination<WH04738>, whereas ye say<WH0559><WTH8802>, The LORD<WH03068> saith<WH05002><WTH8803> <FI>it<Fi> ; albeit I have not spoken<WH0559><WTH8804>?

Therefore thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Because ye have spoken<WH01696><WTH8763> vanity<WH07723>, and seen<WH02372><WTH8804> lies<WH03577>, therefore, behold, I <FI>am<Fi> against you, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>.

And mine hand<WH03027> shall be upon the prophets<WH05030> that see<WH02374> vanity<WH07723>, and that divine<WH07080><WTH8802> lies<WH03577>: they shall not be in the assembly<WH05475> of my people<WH05971>, neither shall they be written<WH03789><WTH8735> in the writing<WH03791> of the house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478>, neither shall they enter<WH0935><WTH8799> into the land<WH0127> of Israel<WH03478>; and ye shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>. <RF>assembly: or, secret, or, counsel<Rf><CM>

Because, even because they have seduced<WH02937><WTH8689> my people<WH05971>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Peace<WH07965>; and <FI>there was<Fi> no peace<WH07965>; and one built up<WH01129><WTH8802> a wall<WH02434>, and, lo<WH02009>, others daubed<WH02902><WTH8802> it with untempered<WH08602> <FI>morter<Fi> : <RF>a wall: or, a slight wall<Rf>

Say<WH0559><WTH8798> unto them which daub<WH02902><WTH8802> <FI>it<Fi> with untempered<WH08602> <FI>morter<Fi> , that it shall fall<WH05307><WTH8799>: there shall be an overflowing<WH07857><WTH8802> shower<WH01653>; and ye<WH0859>, O great hailstones<WH0417><WH068>, shall fall<WH05307><WTH8799>; and a stormy<WH05591> wind<WH07307> shall rend<WH01234><WTH8762> <FI>it<Fi> .
Lo, when the wall<WH07023> is fallen<WH05307><WTH8804>, shall it not be said<WH0559><WTH8735> unto you, Where <FI>is<Fi> the daubing<WH02915> wherewith ye have daubed<WH02902><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> ?

Therefore thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; I will even rend<WH01234><WTH8765> <FI>it<Fi> with a stormy<WH05591> wind<WH07307> in my fury<WH02534>; and there shall be an overflowing<WH07857><WTH8802> shower<WH01653> in mine anger<WH0639>, and great hailstones<WH0417><WH068> in <FI>my<Fi> fury<WH02534> to consume<WH03617> <FI>it<Fi> .

So will I break down<WH02040><WTH8804> the wall<WH07023> that ye have daubed<WH02902><WTH8804> with untempered<WH08602> <FI>morter<Fi> , and bring<WH05060><WTH8689> it down to the ground<WH0776>, so that the foundation<WH03247> thereof shall be discovered<WH01540><WTH8738>, and it shall fall<WH05307><WTH8804>, and ye shall be consumed<WH03615><WTH8804> in the midst<WH08432> thereof: and ye shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.

Thus will I accomplish<WH03615><WTH8765> my wrath<WH02534> upon the wall<WH07023>, and upon them that have daubed<WH02902><WTH8802> it with untempered<WH08602> <FI>morter<Fi> , and will say<WH0559><WTH8799> unto you, The wall<WH07023> <FI>is<Fi> no <FI>more<Fi> , neither they that daubed<WH02902><WTH8802> it;

<FI> To wit<Fi> , the prophets<WH05030> of Israel<WH03478> which prophesy<WH05012><WTH8737> concerning Jerusalem<WH03389>, and which see<WH02374> visions<WH02377> of peace<WH07965> for her, and <FI>there is<Fi> no peace<WH07965>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>.<CM>

Likewise, thou son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, set<WH07760><WTH8798> thy face<WH06440> against the daughters<WH01323> of thy people<WH05971>, which prophesy<WH05012><WTH8693> out of their own heart<WH03820>; and prophesy<WH05012><WTH8734> thou against them,

And say<WH0559><WTH8804>, Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Woe<WH01945> to the <FI>women<Fi> that sew<WH08609><WTH8764> pillows<WH03704> to all armholes<WH0679><WH03027>, and make<WH06213><WTH8802> kerchiefs<WH04555> upon the head<WH07218> of every stature<WH06967> to hunt<WH06679><WTH8780> souls<WH05315>! Will ye hunt<WH06679><WTH8779> the souls<WH05315> of my people<WH05971>, and will ye save<WH02421><WH00> the souls<WH05315> alive<WH02421><WTH8762> <FI>that come<Fi> unto you? <RF>armholes: or, elbows<Rf>

And will ye pollute<WH02490><WTH8762> me among my people<WH05971> for handfuls<WH08168> of barley<WH08184> and for pieces<WH06595> of bread<WH03899>, to slay<WH04191><WTH8687> the souls<WH05315> that should not die<WH04191><WTH8799>, and to save<WH02421><WH00> the souls<WH05315> alive<WH02421><WTH8763> that should not live<WH02421><WTH8799>, by your lying<WH03576><WTH8763> to my people<WH05971> that hear<WH08085><WTH8802> <FI>your<Fi> lies<WH03577>?

Wherefore thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Behold, I <FI>am<Fi> against your pillows<WH03704>, wherewith ye<WH0859> there hunt<WH06679><WTH8781> the souls<WH05315> to make <FI>them<Fi> fly<WH06524><WTH8802>, and I will tear<WH07167><WTH8804> them from your arms<WH02220>, and will let the souls<WH05315> go<WH07971><WTH8765>, <FI>even<Fi> the souls<WH05315> that ye hunt<WH06679><WTH8781> to make <FI>them<Fi> fly<WH06524><WTH8802>. <RF>to make...: or, into gardens<Rf>

Your kerchiefs<WH04555> also will I tear<WH07167><WTH8804>, and deliver<WH05337><WTH8689> my people<WH05971> out of your hand<WH03027>, and they shall be no more in your hand<WH03027> to be hunted<WH04686>; and ye shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.

Because with lies<WH08267> ye have made the heart<WH03820> of the righteous<WH06662> sad<WH03512><WTH8687>, whom I have not made sad<WH03510><WTH8689>; and strengthened<WH02388><WTH8763> the hands<WH03027> of the wicked<WH07451>, that he should not return<WH07725><WTH8800> from his wicked<WH07563> way<WH01870>, by promising him life<WH02421><WTH8687>: <RF>by...: or, that I should save his life: Heb. by quickening him<Rf>

Therefore ye shall see<WH02372><WTH8799> no more vanity<WH07723>, nor divine<WH07080><WTH8799> divinations<WH07081>: for I will deliver<WH05337><WTH8689> my people<WH05971> out of your hand<WH03027>: and ye shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi>  the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>
